entities.name: Genub
entities.description: An Amonkheti human who fell during the Final Hours while searching for his lover Makare.

entities.name: Makare
entities.description: Genub's lover, transformed into a controlled Eternal who killed him.

entities.name: Final Hours
entities.description: The final stage of Amonkhet in which Genub died.

entities.name: Hour of Eternity
entities.description: The hour during which Eternals attacked and Genub searched for Makare.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Blue-armored undead warriors who attacked during the Hour of Eternity.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The ruler whom Genub and Makare defied by their forbidden love.

events.summary: During the Hour of Eternity, Genub searched frantically for Makare and they were separated.
events.quote: Genub frantically searched for his lover, Makare

events.summary: Genub found Makare changed and controlled by a naga wizard; she struck him down with an axe, ending his life.
events.quote: she swung the axe, striking him down

relations.note: Forbidden lovers who defied the God-Pharaoh.
relations.quote: They had pledged their forbidden love to each other months earlier

relations.note: While controlled by a naga wizard.
relations.quote: Her blow, followed by others, ended his life
